LanguageData.VCE_ColdSnap.description: A festive cold snap is freezing the region.
LanguageData.VCE_ColdSnap.label: festive cold
LanguageData.VCE_ColdSnap.letterText: An unusual cold snap has set in.\n\nCold snaps can quickly kill by hypothermia. Be sure to build a heated space to survive, wear appropriate apparel, and try to harvest crops before they freeze and die.
